s.note: Bastian eating his lunch in the attic while he reads
s.how: Butter white bread and fill with sliced ham, cheddar and a spoon of pickle relish. Cut into triangles. Slice 2 red apples and twist a handful of mixed nuts into a paper cone. Pack it all together like a lunch hidden away in a school attic.

Melt 300g dark chocolate. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted almonds, 100g broken sweet biscuits and a handful of coconut. Press into a lined tray and chill for 2 hours. Smash into rough chunky rocks with the handle of a knife.

m.note: the gnome Urgl nursing Atreyu back to health
m.how: Simmer 600g chicken thighs with 100g pearl barley, 2 carrots, a leek and 2 celery sticks in 1.5L water for an hour. Shred the chicken back in, then stir through chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with brown bread.

w.note: flying through the clouds on Falkor
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Spoon big fluffy clouds onto lined trays and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool in the oven and serve with whipped cream and strawberries.

d.note: the long journey to the Southern Oracle
d.how: Brew 4 chamomile tea bags in 1L boiling water with a strip of lemon peel for 5 minutes. Stir in honey. Serve warm in small cups, or cool it and mix half and half with apple juice over ice. Calm enough for any oracle.
